messages:
sam: Heads-up — deploy-bot paused promotion for release v2.4.1. Staging smoke failed; artifact-verify shows partial upload / checksum mismatch. Anyone triage?

deploy-bot: automated: Promotion paused for release=v2.4.1, stage=staging. reason=artifact_verify_failed checksum!=expected. see logs: https://ci.example.com/build/9821/logs :warning:

meera: on it, grabbing logs and contacting storage infra.

jordan: saw multipart upload aborts earlier from runner pool A — runner logs show 503 + client retry. likely related.

ci-bot: build #9821 artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/v2.4.1/manifest.json (partial=0x1c)

meera: storage says a short GC job ran on the mirror bucket at 02:10 UTC, coinciding with the upload. Mirror TTL bump may have raced multipart finalize.

sam: choices: 1) pin to last-good image v2.4.0 and promote, or 2) rerun CI after storage is stable. thoughts?

jordan: pin for safety short-term. Document in release notes and keep rollback plan ready.

lina: +1 pin to unblock, lock deploy window to avoid auto-promote. Can we do canary-only promote first?

meera: last-good digest for v2.4.0: sha256:abcd1234. I can trigger manual promote with approval from release lead @sam.

sam: approve manual promote to prod using sha256:abcd1234. Note: reason=artifact-verify failure; mitigation=pin last-good; follow-up=storage GC investigation; owner=@meera. Change window: immediate.

deploy-bot: ack. Initiating manual promote to prod using image sha256:abcd1234.

srebot: reminder: open incident for storage GC/replication race (severity=high if repeat).

ci-bot: promote job started: job_id=promote-6723. waiting on prechecks.

meera: running quick smoke for payment and auth flows after promote.

jordan: tagging CI rebuild to wait for infra sign-off; don't accept new uploads until mirror stable.

deploy-bot: promote job complete: status=success. prod running v2.4.0 (sha256:abcd1234).

lina: prod smoke looks green for basic endpoints; running longer auth load test.

meera: created incident INC-2026: storage mirror GC raced multipart finalize. Assigned to infra-team with error snippets.

sam: action items: 1) infra patch mirror GC timing and add finalize guard; 2) CI add artifact-verify retry or hard-fail flag and mirror write verification; 3) release-team hold v2.4.1 until rebuild & verify. I'll draft release note: 'Hotfix: pinned to v2.4.0 due to artifact upload verification failure; investigating.'

jordan: adding changelog entry and internal support blurb.

ci-bot: scheduled rebuild for v2.4.1 queued (hold: storage infra confirm).

meera: infra disabled GC runs temporarily and added extra logging. Controlled rebuild planned in ~30m.

sam: closing thread — promoted to last-good and incident opened. Ping here or @oncall if anything changes. :thumbsup:
